name: The Oracle and the Philosopher
source:
Hesperides, a philosopher in Delphis, loses his lover during a storm, trying to leave the city because of the oracle’s prophecy. Hurt, he comes back to confront the oracle and make everyone see that she only tells lies. When she tells another prophecy, Hesperides promises the people that he will prove her prophecies can be broken and beings an adventure of his own.

[From [url=https://tatos.itch.io/the-oracle-and-the-philosopher]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
德尔斐的哲学家Hesperides在试图依照神谕离开城邦时遭遇风暴，并因此失去了恋人。受伤的他回来质问神谕者，要让所有人看清她只会撒谎。当她再次作出预言时，Hesperides向众人承诺，自己会证明她的预言可以被打破，并就此踏上属于自己的冒险。

[来源：[url=https://tatos.itch.io/the-oracle-and-the-philosopher]Itch.io[/url]]
